description:
We build the telephony technologies that keep millions of customers connected every day, including IMS calling, cellular data, network slicing, carrier voicemail, and multi-radio link selection across the iOS and watchOS platforms. These are critical technologies that continuously shape the user experience.

We are looking for a software engineer to help advance intelligence-based software development across both multi-radio and telephony technologies. In this role, you will design and build world-changing algorithms that elevate the experience for millions of customers while exploring the next frontier of AI/ML-driven algorithm design.

Description
You will be challenged with unique problems: building and developing algorithm and software solutions to enrich telephony and multi-radio link selection solutions. 


Minimum qualifications
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering 
Strong C++, C, or Objective-C software skills
GenAI, Familiar with machine learning techniques 

Preferred qualifications
Experience with wireless communications systems 
Ability to write clean, maintainable code in an iOS / watchOS environment
Thrive in a collaborative environment, communicating clearly while authoritatively driving projects across many teams
Obsessively passionate and inquisitive, with a drive to solve everyday problems in innovative ways
Laser-focused on the smallest details that matter most to our customers
Proficiency with AI-based software development tools
